sections.theory:
(vii) Bernoulli random variable takes only two values i.e. ______.

(viii) Pairs of random digits are called ______.

(ix) The successive trails in a Binomial experiment are ______.

(x) The probability of success ______ from trail to trail in a hypergeometric experiment.

3.3 Choose the correct answer.

i) The Binominal distribution was introduced by

(a) Simon Denis Poisson  (b) Jacob Bernoulli

(c) Abraham De Moirés  (d) R.A. Fisher

ii) In a Bernoulli trail the probability of success is denoted by

(a) q  (b) 1-p

(c) p  (d) 1-q

iii) The mean of the Binomial distribution is

(a) \sqrt{np}  (b) npq

(c) np  (d) \sqrt{npq}

iv) If X has a Binomial distribution with p=\frac{2}{3} and n = 9, then its mean will be equal to

(a) 2  (b) 3

(c) 5  (d) 6

v) Hypergeometric probability distribution has parameters

(a) 2  (b) 3

(c) 4  (d) 5

vi) The Binomial distribution is the

(a) equal probability distribution  (b) individual probability distribution

(c) discrete probability distribution  (d) continuous probability distribution

vii) If n = 60, p = 0.7 for a Binomial distribution then its standard deviation is equal to

(a) 42  (b) 6.48

(c) 18  (d) 3.55

viii) If a fair coin is tossed once, the value of p will be

(a) \frac{1}{2}  (b) \frac{1}{3}

(c) \frac{1}{4}  (d) \frac{1}{1}

ix) The number of parameters in a Binomial distribution are

(a) one  (b) two

(c) three  (d) four

x) The range of uniform distribution is equal to;

(a) -\infty to 0  (b) 0,1,\ldots,N

(c) 0 to \infty  (d) 1,2,3,\ldots,N

3.4 Describe in brief the discrete uniform probability distribution.

3.5 What do you know about random digits, random numbers, random number generator and random number table?

3.6 Explain how you would select a random sample of 10 colleges form a list of 206 colleges by using a random number table.

3.5 د تصادفي رقمونو، تصادفي عددونو، د تصادفي عدد جوړوونکي او د تصادفي عددونو د جدول په اړه څه پوهېږئ؟

3.6 تشریح کړئ چې تاسو به د تصادفي عددونو د جدول په کارولو سره د 206 کالجونو له لیست څخه د 10 کالجونو تصادفي نمونه څنګه وټاکئ.
sections.content:
(vii) Bernoulli random variable takes only two values i.e. ______.

(viii) Pairs of random digits are called ______.

(ix) The successive trails in a Binomial experiment are ______.

(x) The probability of success ______ from trail to trail in a hypergeometric experiment.

3.3 Choose the correct answer.

i) The Binominal distribution was introduced by

(a) Simon Denis Poisson  (b) Jacob Bernoulli

(c) Abraham De Moirés  (d) R.A. Fisher

ii) In a Bernoulli trail the probability of success is denoted by

(a) q  (b) 1-p

(c) p  (d) 1-q

iii) The mean of the Binomial distribution is

(a) \sqrt{np}  (b) npq

(c) np  (d) \sqrt{npq}

iv) If X has a Binomial distribution with p=\frac{2}{3} and n = 9, then its mean will be equal to

(a) 2  (b) 3

(c) 5  (d) 6

v) Hypergeometric probability distribution has parameters

(a) 2  (b) 3

(c) 4  (d) 5

vi) The Binomial distribution is the

(a) equal probability distribution  (b) individual probability distribution

(c) discrete probability distribution  (d) continuous probability distribution

vii) If n = 60, p = 0.7 for a Binomial distribution then its standard deviation is equal to

(a) 42  (b) 6.48

(c) 18  (d) 3.55

viii) If a fair coin is tossed once, the value of p will be

(a) \frac{1}{2}  (b) \frac{1}{3}

(c) \frac{1}{4}  (d) \frac{1}{1}

ix) The number of parameters in a Binomial distribution are

(a) one  (b) two

(c) three  (d) four

x) The range of uniform distribution is equal to;

(a) -\infty to 0  (b) 0,1,\ldots,N

(c) 0 to \infty  (d) 1,2,3,\ldots,N

3.4 Describe in brief the discrete uniform probability distribution.

3.5 What do you know about random digits, random numbers, random number generator and random number table?

3.6 Explain how you would select a random sample of 10 colleges form a list of 206 colleges by using a random number table.
